Initialize configuration file with default values

## Synopsis

```text
Creates a new configuration file with default values.

When run inside a Pulumi project, creates project-local configuration at
$PROJECT/.finfocus/config.hujson with a .gitignore to protect user-specific data.
Use --global to force global configuration initialization even inside a project.
```

```text
finfocus config init [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  # Create project-local configuration (inside a Pulumi project)
  finfocus config init

  # Create global configuration
  finfocus config init --global

  # Create configuration, overwriting existing
  finfocus config init --force
```

## Options

```text
      --force[=true|false]    overwrite existing configuration file
      --global[=true|false]   force global configuration init even inside a Pulumi project
  -h, --help[=true|false]     help for init
```
